object.name: evi.korgms20~
object.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation with simultaneous outputs
object.description: The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This Korg filter sits inbetween the more broken <o>evi.korgms10~</o> and the more stable <o>evi.korgms20.select~</o>. It is aggressive but predictable.
object.discussion: Notice that for the 6dB Highpass, filter level is resonance-dependent when resonance is less than 0.5. This is left as a quirky feature, not a bug :-)

inlets.description: Filter resonance 0..1 (0.01..1.476). As in the original analog circuit, highpass output level is resonance dependent!

outlets.description: 6dB highpass output. As in the original analog circuit, highpass output level is resonance dependent!

messages.name: history
messages.digest: Top level gen~ [history] / History() declarations can be reset by messages to the object

attributes.name: oversample
attributes.description: If on (1) the filter is 2x oversampled. If off (0, the default), the filter runs at samplerate. Oversampling is recommended to deal with the nonlinear behaviour of the filter, but is expensive because of the multimode outputs.
